reels.subject: place
reels.caption:
Cabo Girão by boat from Funchal, Madeira: six seconds of cliff, and two yellow dots.

The dots are buoys. Look just above the middle of the water, side by side, like two small eyes keeping watch on the beach.

Behind them: a strip of grey pebbles, then terraces with a few flat roofs and stone walls, then rock in red and green all the way up and out of the frame. The camera gave up before the cliff did.

Nobody built those terraces for the view. They got it anyway.

Duas boias, uma praia, e uma montanha por cima.

Both our trips come along here from the marina. The Day Trip stops at Fajã dos Padres for the swim and paddle, the Sunset Trip turns at Cabo Girão as the light goes. Your group only, five at most.

Six seconds is the Reel. The boat gives you a bit longer. Book direct on chifbay.com
